question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing center midfielder, Claire is playing benchwarmer, Dave is playing cheerleader, Eve is playing goalkeeper, Fred is playing left winger, and Gertrude is playing sweeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Fred and Bob trade positions. Then, Fred and Alice trade positions. Then, Fred and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Eve trade positions. Then, Fred and Eve trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Finally, Alice and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) center midfielder
(C) benchwarmer
(D) cheerleader
(E) goalkeeper
(F) left winger
(G) sweeper
solution:
Each row lists the positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: left midfielder | center midfielder | benchwarmer | cheerleader | goalkeeper | left winger | sweeper
1. Fred–Bob: left midfielder | left winger | benchwarmer | cheerleader | goalkeeper | center midfielder | sweeper
2. Fred–Alice: center midfielder | left winger | benchwarmer | cheerleader | goalkeeper | left midfielder | sweeper
3. Fred–Bob: center midfielder | left midfielder | benchwarmer | cheerleader | goalkeeper | left winger | sweeper
4. Claire–Eve: center midfielder | left midfielder | goalkeeper | cheerleader | benchwarmer | left winger | sweeper
5. Fred–Eve: center midfielder | left midfielder | goalkeeper | cheerleader | left winger | benchwarmer | sweeper
6. Alice–Claire: goalkeeper | left midfielder | center midfielder | cheerleader | left winger | benchwarmer | sweeper
7. Alice–Eve: left winger | left midfielder | center midfielder | cheerleader | goalkeeper | benchwarmer | sweeper
Alice is playing left winger, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
